title: Great service
text: The online booking process was very easy, the address was communicated right after payment. I've easily found the spot, had great communication with the employees there, left luggage for 4 hours, took them back with no problems. Great experience all in all.
author: alexandrapT1736MB

title: Excellent service
text: Ideal, central location and great staff. Would definitely use again. Saves lugging your suitcases and bags around the city.
author: Martha2312

title: So much easier to see the sites without luggage!
text: Easy to find, simple to use. Staff were very friendly. They allowed us to use the restroom and offered for us to bring our son in to get cleaned up when he was covered in gelato! Was great to be able to explore without hauling our cases with us. Would recommend.
author: Dana D

title: Fantastic Idea and saved us quite a bit of money & time
text:
We recently used Stasher in Barcelona for a layover and we were thoroughly impressed with the experience. The site provided all of the necessary reviews and an estimate of the location, which was very accurate. After booking, we received clear instructions on how to find the exact location, making the process seamless. We felt completely safe leaving all of our valuable belongings there, and the cost was a mere 1/4 of what it would have been to leave them at the airport. 

Highly recommend this service for anyone needing a secure and affordable luggage storage solution. It made it possible for

title: Very convenient! Reasonable price
text: Very convenient. The business is new to Stasher but very quickly figured out the drop off and also the return. Reasonable price and convenient. We left a massive bike box for 4 weeks. Worked well.

title: Safe and secure luggage storage
text: Excellent communication about what to do and where to drop off. Close to the train station. Staff were helpful and friendly and I felt safe and comfortable leaving my luggage. Will definitely use again when I got back to Barcelona
